svg.aria-label: Line chart of training loss over one pass through four domains (US government documents, Yoruba, Amharic, news) for three conditions: Learner 1.0 (1x), Learner 1.0 (2x), LoRA r256.
svg.text: Four domains in sequence: training loss for three conditions
Same corpus, same order, one pass
training loss, nats; lines smoothed (moving average, span 31), pale band = raw range of the 1x condition
training step (single pass over the four domains)
All 1,200 steps are drawn for every condition; nothing is subsampled. The unsmoothed per-step loss of all three conditions is in
the companion figure fd_f1b_stream_raw. Source: train_curve.jsonl per condition. Conditions are named by trainable capacity
